newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ head to attend committee meeting at 0216 GMT.
newsitem.headline: BOJ head to attend committee meeting at 0216 GMT.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor Yasuo Matsushita will attend a key parliamentary committee meeting on Thursday at around 11.16 a.m. (0216 GMT), the BOJ said in a statement.
He will answer questions from Liberal Democratic Party member Toranosuke Katayama at the Upper House of parliament's budget committee, it said.
An official at Katayama's office said he was probably going to ask the BOJ governor about the economy and the discount rate in the context of questions about the supplementary budget.
